name: The Itchy Finger
quirks: Scattered aim
Shoots twice as fast
Auto-fire only
Moves at full speed while shooting
unlock_method: Build the Sheriff's Office Blueprint, which is unlocked by clearing the Bone x Yard biome.

name: The Embedded
quirks: Balls pierce enemies until they hit a wall (back wall included)
unlock_method: Build the Veteran's Hut Blueprint, which is unlocked by clearing the Snowy x Shores biome.

name: The Repentant
quirks: Balls gain 5% damage with each bounce
Balls return to you after they hit the back wall, damaging enemies they pass through on the way back
unlock_method: Build the Haunted House Blueprint, which is unlocked by clearing the Snowy x Shores biome.

name: The Cohabitants
quirks: Every ball is fired with a duplicate in the mirrored direction
All balls deal half damage
unlock_method: Build the Cozy Home Blueprint, which is unlocked by clearing the Bone x Yard biome.

name: The Physicist
quirks: Balls are pulled by gravity toward the back wall (balls fired at an angle will curve toward straight)
unlock_method: Build the Laboratory Blueprint, which is unlocked by clearing the Fungal x Forest biome.

name: The Spendthrift
quirks: All balls are fired simultaneously in an arc
unlock_method: Build the Mansion Blueprint, which is unlocked by clearing the Fungal x Forest biome.

name: The Flagellant
quirks: Balls bounce off the bottom of the screen, meaning they must be caught to be re-fired
unlock_method: Build the Monastery Blueprint, which you can unlock by clearing the Gory x Grasslands biome.

name: The Shade
quirks: Balls are fired from the back wall
Balls start with a base critical hit chance of 10%
unlock_method: Build the Mausoleum Blueprint, which is unlocked by clearing the Liminal x Desert biome.

name: The Radical
quirks: Plays the game automatically
Upgrades are chosen automatically
unlock_method: Build the Campground Blueprint, which is unlocked by clearing the Heavenly x Gates biome.

name: The Empty Nester
quirks: No baby balls
Multiple of each equipped special ball are fired
unlock_method: Build the Single Family Home Blueprint, which is unlocked by clearing the Snowy x Shores biome.

name: The Shieldbearer
quirks: Bounces balls off of a shield instead of catching them from the front
A ball's damage doubles every time it bounces off the shield consecutively
Infinite pickup range
Nerfed ball speed
unlock_method: Build the Iron Fortress Blueprint, which is unlocked by clearing the Fungal x Forest biome.

name: The Cogitator
quirks: Upgrades are chosen automatically
unlock_method: Build the Villa Blueprint, which is unlocked by clearing the Snowy x Shores biome.

name: The Tactician
quirks: Battles become turn-based
Infinite pickup range
unlock_method: Build the Captain's Headquarters Blueprint, which is unlocked by clearing the Smoldering x Depths biome.

name: The Juggler
quirks: Balls are launched into the air, rather than straight ahead
Balls only start bouncing after they land in the targeted area
unlock_method: Build the Theater Blueprint, which you can unlock by clearing the Gory x Grasslands biome.

name: The Makeshift Sisyphus
quirks: No baby balls
Balls deal only area-of-effect damage, no direct damage
unlock_method: Unlock the Rocky Hill in the late stages of the game.
